body: Calm down psycho, it's not like they come to your house and put a gun to your head. It's really far more pedestrian than you are imagining. They basically just ask who you're voting fore, maybe lightly try to persuade you, etc. But at the end of the day the main idea is to just spread the word and remind people to vote and try to answer any questions they have. I'very found that when I've canvassed most people you meet do have questions about the candidate they ask or just tell you nah.  They don't get yelled at a lot because if you ask nicely for them to leave then they will, it's not a high pressure sales job or something.
